with ssr as (select s_store_id, sum(sales_price) as sales, sum(profit) as profit, sum(return_amt) as returns, sum(net_loss) as profit_loss 
from (select ss_store_sk as store_sk, ss_sold_date_sk as date_sk, ss_ext_sales_price as sales_price, ss_net_profit as profit, 
cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as return_amt, cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as net_loss 
from store_sales 
where ss_sold_date_sk between cast('2000-08-19' as date) and cast('2000-09-02' as date) 
union all 
select sr_store_sk as store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk as date_sk, cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as sales_price, cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as profit, 
sr_return_amt as return_amt, sr_net_loss as net_loss 
from store_returns 
where sr_returned_date_sk between cast('2000-08-19' as date) and cast('2000-09-02' as date)) salesreturns 
join store on store_sk = s_store_sk 
join date_dim on salesreturns.date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
where date_dim.d_date between cast('2000-08-19' as date) and cast('2000-09-02' as date) 
group by s_store_id), 
csr as (select cp_catalog_page_id, sum(sales_price) as sales, sum(profit) as profit, sum(return_amt) as returns, sum(net_loss) as profit_loss 
from (select cs_catalog_page_sk as page_sk, cs_sold_date_sk as date_sk, cs_ext_sales_price as sales_price, cs_net_profit as profit, 
cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as return_amt, cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as net_loss 
from catalog_sales 
where cs_sold_date_sk between cast('2000-08-19' as date) and cast('2000-09-02' as date) 
union all 
select cr_catalog_page_sk as page_sk, cr_returned_date_sk as date_sk, cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as sales_price, cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as profit, 
cr_return_amount as return_amt, cr_net_loss as net_loss 
from catalog_returns 
where cr_returned_date_sk between cast('2000-08-19' as date) and cast('2000-09-02' as date)) salesreturns 
join catalog_page on page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk 
join date_dim on salesreturns.date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
where date_dim.d_date between cast('2000-08-19' as date) and cast('2000-09-02' as date) 
group by cp_catalog_page_id), 
wsr as (select web_site_id, sum(sales_price) as sales, sum(profit) as profit, sum(return_amt) as returns, sum(net_loss) as profit_loss 
from (select ws_web_site_sk as wsr_web_site_sk, ws_sold_date_sk as date_sk, ws_ext_sales_price as sales_price, ws_net_profit as profit, 
cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as return_amt, cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as net_loss 
from web_sales 
where ws_sold_date_sk between cast('2000-08-19' as date) and cast('2000-09-02' as date) 
union all 
select wr_web_site_sk as wsr_web_site_sk, wr_returned_date_sk as date_sk, cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as sales_price, cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as profit, 
wr_return_amt as return_amt, wr_net_loss as net_loss 
from web_returns 
where wr_returned_date_sk between cast('2000-08-19' as date) and cast('2000-09-02' as date)) salesreturns 
join web_site on wsr_web_site_sk = web_site_sk 
join date_dim on salesreturns.date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
where date_dim.d_date between cast('2000-08-19' as date) and cast('2000-09-02' as date) 
group by web_site_id) 
select channel , id , sum(sales) as sales , sum(returns) as returns , sum(profit) as profit 
from (select 'store channel' as channel , 'store' || s_store_id as id , sales , returns , (profit - profit_loss) as profit from ssr 
union all select 'catalog channel' as channel , 'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id as id , sales , returns , (profit - profit_loss) as profit from csr 
union all select 'web channel' as channel , 'web_site' || web_site_id as id , sales , returns , (profit - profit_loss) as profit from wsr ) x 
group by rollup (channel, id) 
order by channel ,id 
limit 100
